reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Review and release lab reports. Only an authorized reviewer can release, and never the person who uploaded the file.

reports.done: Saved. The list has been updated.
reports.emptyBody: Reports appear here after a file is uploaded for a completed collection.

dashboard.description: Work for {name}. Every number comes from current records.

branches.description: Branch addresses, opening hours, home collection PIN codes and verification.

branches.emptyBody: Branches added during onboarding appear here after they are saved.

catalog.title: Tests and packages
catalog.description: What you offer, the preparation patients must follow and your price. Prices are checked by the server.

catalog.preparationHint: Plain text only. Patients see this before booking.
catalog.saved: Saved. The catalog has been updated.
catalog.priceInvalid: Enter a price between 0 and 1,00,00,000 rupees with up to 2 decimals.
catalog.preparationInvalid: Enter preparation instructions as plain text, up to 500 characters.
catalog.emptyBody: Add tests during onboarding. They appear here once saved.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: People in your organization, their roles and branches. Collectors only see the jobs assigned to them.
staff.inviteNotConnected: Inviting staff is not connected yet. It will use your organization's membership invitations.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Requests and collections for this lab. Decide requests manually; nothing is accepted automatically.
orders.emptyBody: Orders move here when their status changes.

orderDetail.title: Order {reference}
orderDetail.totalsMismatch: The prices sent by the server do not add up. Do not quote this total; contact support.
orderDetail.isRecollection: This order is a recollection request.
orderDetail.paymentNote: Payment is tracked separately and does not change the collection status.
orderDetail.recollectConfirmBody: This creates a new request for the same tests. The failed order stays as it is. No fee is added automatically.

collections.emptyBody: When your manager assigns a collection to you, it appears here.
